tldr: Evening batch, Aug 22: The UK AI Security Institute's psychometric study of 192 models shows safety-benchmark scores are gameable — they measure three unrelated traits (refusal, honesty, context-handling), and ~10 adaptive questions reproduce full-benchmark rankings 97-99% cheaper. Netflix's GenRec (watch history as text, two-stage fine-tune) beat its hand-built recommender in a live A/B with ~40x fewer labels. A new Mental World Modeling framework lifts action-prediction F1 from 63.3 to 87.9 by adding belief/intention variables, UC Berkeley's FreeToken serves a 284B MoE on a gaming desktop, and llama.cpp shipped its first stable semver release v0.2.0. Anthropic GA'd computer use, browser use, Skills and Files APIs on the Claude Platform (also on Microsoft Foundry), and the Economist's AI-homework study — scores up, exams down — is the weekend's hottest HN thread.

articles.title: UK AISI Study: Safety-Benchmark Scores Are Gameable — They Don't Measure "Safety"
articles.summary: 192 models, 8 benchmarks: safety scores measure refusal, honesty and context-handling — not one trait; ~10 adaptive questions reproduce full rankings.

articles.title: Netflix's GenRec Beats Its Years-Old Recommendation Engine in a Live A/B
articles.summary: Watch history as text + two-stage fine-tune: +1.6% offline quality, ~40x fewer labels, and a live 10%-traffic A/B beat production on both metrics.

articles.title: Mental World Modeling: Physics-Only World Models Predict the Wrong Actions
articles.summary: Adding belief/intention variables (MENTIS + Menti-Bench) lifts action-prediction F1 from 63.3 to 87.9 across GPT-5.6 Sol, Opus 4.8 and others — humans score 98.5.

articles.title: FreeToken: Serving a 284B MoE on a Gaming Desktop
articles.summary: UC Berkeley engine turns one machine into an elastic inference platform: 35B on a laptop, 284B on a gaming desktop, ~100 tok/s on Qwen3.6-35B-A3.

articles.title: llama.cpp v0.2.0 — First Stable Semver Release
articles.summary: vX.Y.Z tags now mark stable builds for downstream projects while b[] tags stay nightly — every local-inference toolchain gets a sane upgrade path.

articles.title: Anthropic GAs Computer Use, Browser Use, Skills API and Files API
articles.summary: Agent tooling GA: computer use takes multi-action turns (20-40% fewer round trips), Skills run sandboxed, Files API adds 1TB/org — also on Foundry.

articles.title: Economist Study: AI Lifted Homework Scores, Then Exam Scores Dropped
articles.summary: The weekend's hottest HN thread (320 pts): AI help on homework masks weaker learning — watch school-policy fallout as term starts.
